items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: He made some records with Jimmy Noon I think.

ctx.x: Yeah. Red Toots told me. He can play any style.

Yeah. But I tell you what, he can play classical music. Oh, yeah. He's just a good musician. Yeah. He's just a good period. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. He made some records with Jimmy Noon I think. Yeah. Yeah. In Chicago. Yeah. Has Adam ever recorded?
Yeah but I don't know who he recorded with. He made a whole lot of recordings. Down in San Diego he made some somewhere up in Ohio.
